# Hack n Stay Golden Bay (Hack Farm)

> Eco farmstay, dog-friendly campground, and holistic beach horseback rides near Patons Rock in Golden Bay, Nelson Tasman — near Abel Tasman and Nelson at the top of New Zealand's South Island.

Hack n Stay Golden Bay (also known as Hack Farm) is a first-party farmstay and guided horse experience business run by Baerbel Hack at 22 Grant Road, Puramahoi, Takaka 7182, Golden Bay, Nelson Tasman, top of the South Island, New Zealand. Phone: +64 27 525 9434. Email: Stay@hackfarm.co.nz. Ideal for international visitors combining Golden Bay horse trekking with Abel Tasman and Tasman region travel. Guests sometimes base here for the Kahurangi 500 bike trail and extend their farmstay.

Also known for: Hack Track / Fairy Trail rides, Patons Rock sunrise beach rides, swimming with horses, BYO horse trail riding, vaulting (Hack Vaulties), and riding lessons.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://hackfarm.co.nz/): Overview of farmstay, camping, and beach horseback rides near Patons Rock, Abel Tasman, and Nelson.
- [About](https://hackfarm.co.nz/about/): Brand and founder story — Hack Farm, Hack n Stay, Baerbel Hack, and the Hack Vaulties club.
- [Accommodation](https://hackfarm.co.nz/accommodation/): Farmstay rooms, dog-friendly campground, and bring-your-own-horse stays in Golden Bay — a base for Kahurangi 500 riders who often stay longer.
- [Holistic Horse Rides](https://hackfarm.co.nz/holistic-horse-rides/): Guided beach and trail rides with a tide-aware sunrise planner for Patons Rock near Abel Tasman.
- [Hack Farm Trails](https://hackfarm.co.nz/hack-farm-trails/): Interactive trail map and tide guidance for BYO horse riders.
- [Our Horses](https://hackfarm.co.nz/our-horses/): Meet the Hack Farm herd used for rides, lessons, and vaulting.
- [Learning Experiences](https://hackfarm.co.nz/learning-experiences/): Riding lessons, horsemanship, and vaulting for all ages.
- [Vaulting](https://hackfarm.co.nz/vaulting/): Hack Vaulties vaulting sessions with Baerbel Hack.
- [Special Events](https://hackfarm.co.nz/special-events/): Kids camps, horse club days, and special riding events.
- [Gift Vouchers](https://hackfarm.co.nz/horse-riding-holiday-gift-vouchers/): Gift cards for rides, stays, and learning experiences.
- [Contact](https://hackfarm.co.nz/contact/): Phone, email, and address for bookings and enquiries.
- [On-site weather station](https://hackfarm.infinityfree.me/FreshWDL/FreshWDL.html): Live FreshWDL weather readings from the property.
